zh: 窄屏输入栏的固定控件（思考深度、语音、发送、计量环）不再被压扁重叠，模型名与权限文字先缩短，首页页宽不足时右侧控件整组换行并保持靠右，会话宽窄布局都保持单行
en: Narrow composer bars no longer squeeze their fixed controls (effort, voice, send, meter ring) into each other, the model name and permission text shorten first, the new-conversation card wraps its right-hand cluster to a second right-aligned line when the page is too narrow, and the conversation row stays on one line in both layouts
